category_title: Students who procrastinate on work plans until the final deadline
scenario_title: Low-achieving student struggling to initiate multi-week work plan
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a study lesson with a new multi-week work plan for math and science.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the new math and science work plan for the next three weeks. You can go ahead and start working at your own pace.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the work plan on the desk and stares at it without opening the book) Okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you will work on first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I normally procrastinate because I struggle to get started.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, just try your best to get something done during this study lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans back in the chair) This is how I normally work: At school, the first couple of weeks, I do nothing. I'll just delay the work plan until the last few days.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is the new math and science work plan for the next three weeks. You can go ahead and start working at your own pace.

STUDENT: (Puts the work plan on the desk and stares at it without opening the book) Okay.

TUTOR: What do you think you will work on first?

STUDENT: I don't know. I normally procrastinate because I struggle to get started.

TUTOR: Well, just try your best to get something done during this study lesson.

STUDENT: (Leans back in the chair) This is how I normally work: At school, the first couple of weeks, I do nothing. I'll just delay the work plan until the last few days.

task.content: Working on math and science tasks assigned in a work plan over a two or three week period.

context.environment: Study lessons—that is, lessons devoted to working on the assignments from the work plan
context.materials: work plan containing various tasks and requirements
context.social_setting: students are working at their own pace
context.time_context: vary between 2 and 10 hours per week

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Attempting to begin work on a new set of tasks in a work plan at the start of a new period.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: spend most of the school time ‘almost doing nothing’
related_quotes: This is how I normally work: At school, the ﬁrst couple of weeks, I do nothing, but sometimes I manage to complete a couple of tasks every lesson.

behavior_patterns.condition: During classroom 'study lessons' where students are working at their own pace.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: do little required schoolwork within the ﬁrst weeks of the work-plan period and delaying their required work until the last few days
